notes.title: Tell us about your adventures in Piggy Jump
notes.content:
Tell us about your experience in Piggy Jump!
Let us know what you liked and disliked about game!
We want to make the gameplay experience better.

notes.title: Know more about Piggy Jump.
notes.content:
Piggy Jump is a game created by 19 years old solo developer.
In this event all piggy jump players and gamers who are interested in playing piggy jump in the future are invited to make the game more interesting and better. Check out the game and try to figure out what you would like to change or add. I am a solo developer and I would like to hear some advice from gamers who play piggy jump. Help me to improve the game with your advice or review.[previewyoutube=BDdASaZYWQ4;full][/previewyoutube]
